title: Tierwise provenance case
description: One provenance case (spec section 12.7, [VEC-126] to [VEC-131]): a sidecar file checked against a bundle file. The case names both files and expects the sidecar to be accepted, or rejected with E_PROVENANCE_INVALID. No evaluator runs a provenance case. [VEC-112] requires every provenance case to validate against this schema. This schema checks structure only. The check tool checks that id equals the file path relative to provenance/ and is unique ([VEC-127]), that bundle resolves to a file in bundles/ and not in bundles/invalid/, that sidecar resolves to a .json file under provenance/ ([VEC-128]), and that each clause exists and is not OPEN ([VEC-16]). The sidecar itself is checked against provenance.schema.json and [BUNDLE-151] by the tool that runs the case ([VEC-130]).

id.description: Case identifier. It equals the file path relative to provenance/, without the .yaml extension, and is unique among the provenance cases ([VEC-11], [VEC-127]).

specVersion.description: Version of this specification that the case targets. The value for this version is "0.1" ([VEC-14]).

clauses.description: Clause IDs that define the behaviour the case checks ([VEC-16], [VEC-131]).

description.description: One non-empty, single-line sentence that says what the case checks ([VEC-17]).

bundle.description: Relative path, from the directory of the case file, to a canonical bundle file directly inside bundles/ and not inside bundles/invalid/ ([VEC-128]). The pattern checks only that the path is relative, uses / and ends in bundles/ followed by one file name, which excludes bundles/invalid/. The check tool checks that the path resolves to the suite's bundles/ directory.

sidecar.description: Relative path, from the directory of the case file, to the sidecar under test: a .json file under provenance/ ([VEC-126], [VEC-128]). The pattern checks only that the path is relative, uses / and ends in .json. The check tool checks that it resolves under provenance/.

expect.description: The expected outcome: exactly one of accept, whose value is true, or error, whose value is E_PROVENANCE_INVALID ([VEC-129]). Messages are not compared ([VEC-130], [VEC-52]).

oneOf.description: The sidecar is accepted for the bundle ([VEC-129]).

accept.description: Always true: the sidecar is expected to be accepted ([VEC-129]).

oneOf.description: The sidecar is rejected with E_PROVENANCE_INVALID ([VEC-129], [BUNDLE-151]).

error.description: The only code a provenance case can expect ([VEC-129]).

clauseId.description: A clause ID: an area prefix from spec.md, a hyphen and a number from 1 ([VEC-16]).
